data.title: Robot Model Gallery: Download URDF Robots for ARMOR
data.description: Browse robot models compatible with ARMOR and open them straight on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Humanoids, industrial arms, quadrupeds, and open-source desktop robots, each with a one-tap import.
